newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar cuts March crude formulas--traders.
newsitem.headline: Qatar cuts March crude formulas--traders.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has cut its price formula for March-lifting Qatar Land crude by 21 cents per barrel and that for Qatar Marine by 27 cents per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Monday.

According to the QGPC formula, March Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 40 cents per barrel, which translated into $19.50 per barrel, and March Qatar Marine at Oman plus 26 cents per barrel or $19.36.
February Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 61 cents per barrel or $20.33 and February Qatar Marine at Oman plus 53 cents or $20.25 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman crude issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals.
